headline: Sample: national regulator publishes updated BVLOS guidance
summary: Demonstration record showing how a regulatory update appears in the live intelligence feed. Replace this sample with a verified source before publishing.
impact_reason: A change to BVLOS requirements could directly affect DFR, dock deployments, customer programme design, approval timelines and solution engineering advice.

headline: Sample: public-safety agency issues an RPAS procurement notice
summary: Demonstration procurement item for testing impact badges, filters and business-impact wording.
impact_reason: This may represent an immediate sales opportunity. Confirm scope, closing date, incumbent suppliers, procurement route and account ownership.

headline: Sample: manufacturer releases a dock or aircraft software update
summary: Demonstration technology update showing a medium-impact item.
impact_reason: Review whether the update changes compatibility, remote-operation capability, security posture, customer workflows or integration requirements.

headline: Sample: government announces emergency-services technology funding
summary: Demonstration political and budget intelligence record.
impact_reason: New funding can accelerate public-safety modernisation and create near-term opportunities. Identify eligible agencies, budget timing and procurement conditions.

headline: Sample: police agency announces a DFR trial
summary: Demonstration agency update for a high-impact operational programme.
impact_reason: A DFR trial indicates operational demand, stakeholder momentum and potential requirements for command, livestreaming, evidence, CAD integration and remote operations.
